generate_copt_files: run generate_copts.py to create Starlark and CMake compile option config files from copts.py
generate_copt_file_starlark: generate a Starlark copt file using StarlarkStyle for Bazel build configuration
generate_copt_file_cmake: generate a CMake copt file using CMakeStyle for CMake build configuration
copt_list_format: format a list of compile options into styled output using copt_list with a style object
review_cmake_style_class: review the CMakeStyle class methods for separator, list_introducer, list_closer, docstring, and filename
